description: JACKSON, MI (WTVB) – Branch County’s representative in Congress Tim Walberg has gotten the endorsement of former President Donald Trump. Walberg is running for re-election in the newly created Fifth Congressional District. He is being opposed in the August 2 G.O.P. Primary by Sherry O’Donnell and Bryan Trouten.
